input: Set a weekly step goal on my fitness tracker

gold.taskTitle: Set a weekly step goal on fitness tracker
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to configure a weekly step goal on their fitness tracker device or app.

questions.title: Which fitness tracker brand or app do you use?
questions.description: Identify the specific device or platform (e.g., Fitbit, Garmin, Apple Watch, Google Fit) to tailor the setup steps.

questions.title: What weekly step count are you aiming for?
questions.description: Determine the exact numeric goal the user wants to set, such as 70,000 steps per week.

questions.title: Do you currently track a daily step goal instead?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user is switching from a daily goal to a weekly one, or setting a step goal for the first time.

questions.title: Which day should your weekly step cycle reset on?
questions.description: Find out the preferred start day of the week (e.g., Monday or Sunday) for the goal period.

questions.title: Do you want reminders if you fall behind mid-week?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants progress alerts or nudges throughout the week to stay on track.

questions.title: Are you setting this goal for fitness, weight loss, or another reason?
questions.description: Understand the underlying motivation so the recommended step target can be appropriately calibrated.

questions.title: Do you have a phone, smartwatch, or both to configure?
questions.description: Clarify the device setup environment, since some trackers require changes via a companion app on a phone rather than the device itself.
